title: Tinman backend-neutral sandbox specification
description: The portable, backend-neutral shape every sandbox backend reads. Referenced by features/sandbox-specification.feature. No Bubblewrap mechanics appear here.

home.description: How the sandbox home directory is provisioned.

network.description: How the sandboxed process reaches the network. deny gives it no route at all, allow gives it the host's, and proxy gives it one route through a proxy Tinman runs, so every exchange is observable and the credential stays outside the sandbox.

egress.description: How egress is treated. Read only where network is proxy.

har.description: The HTTP Archive file the exchange is recorded to when recording, and served from when replaying.

fault.description: A fault injected into every exchange, so a condition the real provider will not produce on demand can be tested.

status.description: An HTTP status served instead of the upstream response.

latency.description: A delay applied before the response is served, as a duration such as 2s.

offline.description: Whether the connection is refused outright.

path.description: Controlled PATH entries visible inside the sandbox.

env.description: Environment variables injected into the sandbox.
